title: Longest Balanced Fragment
description: Given a binary string, find the length of the longest contiguous fragment containing an equal number of 0s and 1s.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; the string contains only 0 and 1.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: the binary string.
outputFormat: Print the maximum length of a balanced fragment.
hints: Treat 0 as -1 and 1 as +1. Equal prefix sums mark a balanced interval.

examples.explanation: The fragment 0110 contains two 0s and two 1s.
The fragment 1100 contains two 1s and two 0s.
